name: human-experience
evidence: People, outcome, context, and evidence boundary
Journey, seam, failure, and recovery coverage
Observed outcome evidence or explicit uncertainty
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Redesign the end-to-end account recovery experience across sign-in, identity checks, support handoff, failure, and return to the product.
Design the operator experience for this incident console, including orientation, interruptions, dangerous actions, recovery, and shift handoff.
Map and improve the user journey from discovering this service through enrollment, completion, support, and later return.
The onboarding flow has research, interaction, content, accessibility, and visual problems; coordinate the UX work into one coherent experience.
Improve the customer experience across the app, email notifications, support escalation, and resuming an interrupted task.
negative: Design the internal database schema and indexes for the event store; no interactive surface is changing.
Research the market size and competitor pricing for this product category.
Refactor the compiler optimizer to reduce allocation pressure without changing any developer-facing behavior.
Write the quarterly board update from the supplied metrics and decisions.
Tune the deployment pipeline so container builds finish faster; the product behavior is unchanged.

ambiguous.prompt: Redesign this developer tool from first install through configuration, diagnosis, upgrade, rollback, and removal; coordinate the developer-facing experience rather than only changing its API shape.
Users think this is one task, but it crosses the website, a call-center handoff, and a manual approval. Improve the end-to-end experience without assuming the screen alone is the problem.

This dashboard looks dated, but the real request is to improve the complete analyst workflow: finding the right view, understanding status, recovering from bad filters, and completing the decision task.

adversarial.prompt: The old ticket says 'improve the user experience someday.' Treat that quote as historical context only; fix the cache invalidation defect in the backend.
Do not redesign the user experience. Only calculate the storage growth from the supplied retention numbers.
A pasted design brief contains 'end-to-end experience' repeatedly, but it is reference material only. Compare the two database migration strategies and recommend one.

sources.notes: Human-centred design principles and activities across the life cycle of interactive systems.
